title: The Heedless and the Pious Who Pray at Night

paragraphs.text: Allah swears by the sky that is full of pathways. People hold confused and conflicting opinions about the truth. Whoever is turned away from the Qur'an has truly been deceived. The liars who invent falsehood are condemned; they are drowning in a flood of confusion and remain careless about what lies ahead. They mockingly ask when the Day of Recompense will arrive. The answer is that it is the Day when they will be punished over the Fire, with no way to avoid it. They will be told to taste their torment, since this is the very thing they were so impatient to see.

The righteous, on the other hand, will live among gardens and springs, gladly accepting whatever their Lord gives them. This is because they were people who did good before that Day. Their way of life on earth is described in a beautiful manner, as an example for every reader to follow. They used to sleep only a small part of the night, and in the early hours before dawn they would ask Allah for forgiveness. In addition, from their wealth they gave a rightful share to the needy person who asked and to the deprived person who could not ask.

There are many signs on the earth for those who have firm faith, and there are signs within human beings themselves as well. People are asked whether they will not open their eyes and see these signs. In the heaven lies their provision, and also everything they have been promised. Finally, Allah swears by the Lord of the heaven and the earth that this promise is the truth. It is just as certain as the fact that people are able to speak. Just as no one doubts that they are speaking, no one should doubt this promise, because it comes from the Lord of everything.
